rewrites.comment: Proxy the API through this origin. Requests become first-party, so ad-blocker filter lists and enterprise URLBlocklist rules that target onrender.com no longer match them — and CORS stops applying at all. Must be listed before the SPA fallback: the first matching rewrite wins.
SPA fallback so deep links like /parcels/PF-YUH5F-P6VFX reach index.html instead of 404ing. Excludes /api so it can never shadow the proxy above.
